_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site A#000.dst: クエストライン開始: WynnExcavation

WynnExcavation Site A#001.dst: Vade に言われて来たの？

WynnExcavation Site A#002.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh, and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#002.dst: 石板ひとつ完成！Vade に返してね。あ、読んじゃダメよ！

WynnExcavation Site A#003.src: A strange force pushes you back!
WynnExcavation Site A#003.dst: 奇妙な力に押し戻された！

WynnExcavation Site A#004.src: What are you still doing over here? Go finish your assignment! It's written in your content book.
WynnExcavation Site A#004.dst: まだこんな所で何してんだ？さっさと仕事を終わらせろ！コンテンツブックに書いてあるだろ。

WynnExcavation Site A#005.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる発掘者 Vade と話す

WynnExcavation Site A#006.src: Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
WynnExcavation Site A#006.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#007.src: I need you to translate this ancient text.
WynnExcavation Site A#007.dst: この古代文書を翻訳してもらいたい。
WynnExcavation Site A#007.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#008.dst: 研究助手の Tesha に持っていくだけでいい。
WynnExcavation Site A#008.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#009.src: I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
WynnExcavation Site A#009.dst: 自分で行ってもいいが、俺みたいな大物が雑用なんてやれるか！研究所は上のテントだ。翻訳に傷なんかつけるなよ！
WynnExcavation Site A#009.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
WynnExcavation Site A#010.dst: 古代の文書を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] のテントにいる Tesha に届ける

WynnExcavation Site A#011.dst: WynnExcavation 研究所へようこそ！
WynnExcavation Site A#011.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#012.dst: Vade に言われて来たの？
WynnExcavation Site A#012.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#013.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.dst: そうそう、待ってた石板！
WynnExcavation Site A#013.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#015.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..
WynnExcavation Site A#015.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Here, let me finish this up...
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#018.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#018.dst: 石板ひとつ完成！Vade に返してね。あ、読んじゃダメよ！
WynnExcavation Site A#018.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#019.src: Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
WynnExcavation Site A#019.dst: 翻訳された文書を持って発掘者 Vade のもとへ戻る

WynnExcavation Site A#021.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#021.dst: ああ、俺が使いに出した小僧か！
WynnExcavation Site A#021.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#022.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?
WynnExcavation Site A#022.dst: で、翻訳は持ってきたのか？
WynnExcavation Site A#022.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#023.src: You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
WynnExcavation Site A#023.dst: 持ってるな！上出来だ！どれ、見せてみろ…
WynnExcavation Site A#023.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#024.dst: 「際立つ木に供物を投げよ。正しき角度が道を開く」
WynnExcavation Site A#024.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#025.src: I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.dst: 神殿の中のことを言ってるのか…おっと、お前がいるのを忘れてた。首を突っ込むなよ小僧、大人の仕事だ！
WynnExcavation Site A#025.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#026.src: Solve this riddle in the tomb: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#026.dst: 墓の中でこの謎を解く:「際立つ木に供物を投げよ。正しき角度が道を開く」

WynnExcavation Site A#028.src: Return and talk to Excavator Vade
WynnExcavation Site A#028.dst: 戻って発掘者 Vade と話す

WynnExcavation Site A#029.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?
WynnExcavation Site A#029.dst: おい小僧、今墓から出てきたのか？
WynnExcavation Site A#029.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#030.src: I knew I shouldn't have been so lazy and got someone else to do the leg work!
WynnExcavation Site A#030.dst: 怠けて他人に足を使わせるんじゃなかった！
WynnExcavation Site A#030.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#031.src: Gosh, I can't tell my boss about this, he'll have my head! Literally! Wynn Excavation is not a group you want to betray, they are more powerful than you will ever know.
WynnExcavation Site A#031.dst: くそっ、ボスには言えねえ、首が飛ぶ！文字通りな！Wynn Excavation は裏切っちゃいけねえ組織だ。お前の想像以上に力を持ってる。
WynnExcavation Site A#031.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#032.src: YOU'D BETTER NOT HAVE TAKEN ANYTHING! THAT IS OFFICIAL WYNNEXCAVATION PROPERTY!
WynnExcavation Site A#032.dst: 何も持ち出してねえだろうな！あれは WYNNEXCAVATION の正式な所有物だ！
WynnExcavation Site A#032.speaker: Excavator Vade
